title: VisibilitySessionState
description: Current materialized topology workbench state stored for a visibility session.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the session state was last updated.

updatedByRunId.description: Run id that last updated the session state.

updatedByMessageId.description: Message id that last updated the session state.

base.description: Base graph compatibility key for all layers in this session state.

layers.description: Current materialized overlay layers in the session.

graphOverlays.description: Current materialized graph overlays in the session.
